## Spring 2027 Courses

Each course is listed once with all of its open sections. For courses with a lab, register for one lecture section and one lab section; the section letters don't need to match. Courses marked *1st half* or *2nd half* meet for only half the semester. Click "Description" to see the catalog description.

```{=html}
<style>
.courses td { vertical-align: top; }
.courses .crs { width: 55%; font-size: 1.05em; }
.courses td:last-child { font-size: 0.88em; color: #495057; }
```

```{python}
#| output: false

import json
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from html import escape

with open("CourseSchedule-27SP.json") as f:
    report = json.load(f)["report"]

# Only regular Spring-term sections that are still open (skips Winter Intensive).
report = [
    r for r in report
    if r["Status"] != "Closed" and r["AcadPeriod"].startswith("2027 Spring")
]


def meeting(r):
    parts = []
    for seg in r["MtgPattern"].split(";"):
        fields = [f.strip() for f in seg.split("|")]
        if fields[0]:
            parts.append(" ".join(fields[:2]))
    return ", ".join(parts) or "TBA"


def half(r):
    """'1st half' / '2nd half' for 7-week courses, else None."""
    start, end = r["StartDt"][5:], r["EndDt"][5:]
    if start >= "03-01":
        return "2nd half"
    if end <= "03-31":
        return "1st half"
    return None


def course_num(r):
    # "108L" -> ("108", True)
    m = re.match(r"(\d+)(L?)", r["Crs_Number"])
    return m.group(1), bool(m.group(2))


def sortkey(num):
    return int(re.match(r"\d+", num).group())


# Cross-listings: same title, time, and instructor under different subjects.
xlist = defaultdict(set)
for r in report:
    xlist[(r["Section_Title"], r["MtgPattern"], r["Instructors"])].add(
        f"{r['Subject_RefID']} {r['Crs_Number']}"
    )


def cross_listed(r):
    me = f"{r['Subject_RefID']} {r['Crs_Number']}"
    return sorted(xlist[(r["Section_Title"], r["MtgPattern"], r["Instructors"])] - {me})


def section_item(r):
    h = half(r)
    tag = ""
    if h:
        dates = f"{r['StartDt'][5:].replace('-', '/')}–{r['EndDt'][5:].replace('-', '/')}"
        tag = f' <span class="tag{" h2" if h.startswith("2") else ""}" title="{dates}">{h}</span>'
    return (
        f"<li><b>{escape(r['Sec_Number'])}</b> · {escape(meeting(r))} · "
        f"{escape(r['Instructors'])}{tag}</li>"
    )


def hours(lectures, labs):
    hrs = sorted({r["Hours"] for r in lectures})
    s = "/".join(hrs) + (" hr" if hrs == ["1"] else " hrs")
    if labs:
        s += f" + {labs[0]['Hours']} hr lab"
    return s


def show(subj):
    courses = defaultdict(lambda: {"lec": [], "lab": []})
    for r in report:
        if r["Subject_RefID"] != subj:
            continue
        num, is_lab = course_num(r)
        courses[num]["lab" if is_lab else "lec"].append(r)

    print('<table class="table table-sm courses"><tbody>')
    for num in sorted(courses, key=sortkey):
        lec = sorted(courses[num]["lec"], key=lambda r: r["Sec_Number"])
        lab = sorted(courses[num]["lab"], key=lambda r: r["Sec_Number"])
        first = (lec or lab)[0]

        # Special-topics courses put the real description in Notes.
        desc = escape(next((r["Desc"].strip() for r in lec + lab if r["Desc"]), ""))
        notes = (first["Notes"] or "")
        if "Special Topic" in notes:
            desc = re.sub(r"\s*Fee: \$\d+", "", notes) + (f"<p>{desc}</p>" if desc else "")

        print("<tr><td class='crs'>")
        print(f"<span class='num'>{subj} {num}</span> {escape(first['Section_Title'])}")
        print(f"<div class='meta'>{hours(lec, lab)}</div>")
        xl = cross_listed(first)
        if xl:
            print(f"<div class='xlist'>Cross-listed as {' and '.join(xl)}</div>")
        if desc:
            print(f"<details><summary>Description</summary>{desc}</details>")
        print("</td><td>")
        if lab:
            print("<div class='kind'>Lecture: pick one</div>" if len(lec) > 1 else "<div class='kind'>Lecture</div>")
        print("<ul>" + "".join(section_item(r) for r in lec) + "</ul>")
        if lab:
            print("<div class='kind'>Lab: pick any one</div>" if len(lab) > 1 else "<div class='kind'>Lab</div>")
            print("<ul>" + "".join(section_item(r) for r in lab) + "</ul>")
        print("</td></tr>")
    print("</tbody></table>\n")
```

### Computer Science (CS)

```{python}
#| output: asis
show("CS")
```
